clips.title: The story
paras: Crocolisk skins are harvested from the tough hides of the crocolisks inhabiting the islands and waters of the Loch in Loch Modan. Prized by merchants and leatherworkers for their durability, they fetch a respectable price despite the danger involved in securing them.

The cold waters of the Loch teem with aggressive crocolisks that make their dens along the lake's islands and shores. Hunting them is no simple task, as these ferocious beasts possess razor-sharp teeth and thick, resilient scales capable of turning away careless blades. Despite the hazards, hunters operating out of Farstrider Lodge frequently harvest the creatures. Tailors, leatherworkers, and distant merchants continually seek out the skins to craft durable garments and protective armor, making a bundle of undamaged hides a valuable trade commodity in the region.
